text:
Jordan Li: quick flag from the nightly crawler  runbook/incident-handling.html has 4 internal 404s in staging (steps that link to /playbooks/old-restart + a dead diagram). Not blocking but awkward for oncall. who can own a tiny fix?
link-scan-bot: scan: 2026-03-22T07:30Z  4 dead internal links found in runbook/incident-handling.html; examples: /playbooks/old-restart, /diagrams/incident-flow.svg (404). full: https://internal-reports.redwood/scans/2990012345
Nina Patel: I edited that runbook two weeks ago when we shuffled playbooks. I think the old-restart page got moved under /playbooks/restart. I can patch in a couple quick replacements.
Jordan Li: awesome, if you can open a PR tag @Ravi S for CR and @docs-oncall for a merge after CI that'd be perfect.
Nina Patel: local sed I used to test:
```bash
rg "/playbooks/old-restart|/diagrams/incident-flow.svg" -n docs/ && \
sed -n 's@/playbooks/old-restart@/playbooks/restart@g; s@/diagrams/incident-flow.svg@/assets/diagrams/incident-flow.svg@g' -i docs/runbook/incident-handling.html
```
Nina Patel: also rehosted the diagram under /assets/diagrams/ (upload included in PR). Will add a changelog line: "rename: playbooks/old-restart -> playbooks/restart (internal link fixes)"
Ravi S: will review once PR is up. tiny nit: please keep the link text as "Restart playbook" exactly so translations pick it up.
Nina Patel: good catch, keeping text unchanged. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/8110  includes path fixes + uploaded svg + changelog note. tagging @Ravi S @docs-oncall
Ravi S: quick CR done, LGTM. one tiny suggestion inline about alt text on the diagram.
Nina Patel: pushed alt text fix. CI passing.
docs-oncall: thanks for the low-risk patch. will merge after final CI green to ensure staging is updated before tomorrow's drill.
link-scan-bot: re-scan scheduled post-merge.
Jordan Li: thanks all 64f; will watch the re-scan and ping if anything else pops up.
